round_purpose: First real training closed-loop validation of the fresh response controller. Answer Q1 single-shot effectiveness (controller vs no-op), Q2 adaptive vs fixed-j1, Q3 economics (equal-wall-clock). NOT a new algorithm; controller computation structure untouched.

frozen_science_semantics.candidates: j=0 no-op (native AdamW step); j in {1,2,3,4}: inject g^lambda = g + lambda*(g_j - g) at the real step, where g = native gradient of the real training batch at the event step and g_j = full gradient of candidate data group j-1 at the event state (production candidate identity, 4 frozen data groups from train pool, Philox batches via candidate_batches_for)
frozen_science_semantics.selector: j* = argmin_j (lambda * hhat_j), hhat_0 = 0 exactly, tie -> smallest action id
frozen_science_semantics.scorer: production shared-adjoint FULL_GRAD_DOT hhat_j (run_adjoint_only scores_hhat_adj), hvp_fp32=True (frozen production candidate)
frozen_science_semantics.decision_computation: pe.run_adjoint_only on the event snapshot with a live-manifest ctx/stream (E2 recipe: two_level_seed(E2_STREAM_BASE_SEED, seed, step, stream_id=0), batch_seed=derive_stream_seed(stream_seed,404), batches_from_train_pool); candidates from frozen group_definition members; NO cache, NO stale gradients, NO JVP scoring, NO block planning

frozen_environment.config: research/configs/e3c_confirmatory_v07.json (hidden 256 x 4 layers, seq 128, batch 4, accum 2, bf16, clip 1.0, lr 5e-4, planned_total_optimizer_steps=128, total_micro_steps=256)
frozen_environment.training_loop: e3c native AdamW recipe: setup_seed(train_seed) -> init_model(from_weight='none') -> AdamW -> batches_from_train_pool(train_indices, 4, train_seed+1704, 256 micro) -> per-micro set_native_micro_lr -> autocast fwd/bwd /accum -> scaler.unscale_ -> clip_grad_norm_(1.0) -> scaler.step+update -> zero_grad
frozen_environment.eval: frozen validation_split.json v_score (64) / v_eval (64) as pre-stacked tensors, a0g._val_loss_only, RNG wrapped (capture/restore) so eval consumes no trajectory RNG; eval every 10 optimizer steps at steps 10..128
frozen_environment.identity_guarantee: all 3 arms of a seed share identical init (setup_seed before init_model), identical data order, identical dropout RNG sequence; control events are invisible to the real trajectory RNG (save/restore around all controller computation); arm A must bitwise-reproduce e3c v0.7 bank state hashes at steps 46/52 (engineering smoke S1/S2)

groups.A: pure AdamW baseline (u=0, no extra compute)
groups.B: fixed intervention j=1 at the same control steps as C (fresh g_1 recomputed at each event, RNG-wrapped); isolates adaptive selection as the only C-vs-B difference
groups.C: fresh response controller: at each control step t: save full state+RNG snapshot -> run_adjoint_only decision on snapshot -> restore snapshot+RNG -> execute chosen action once at real step t

cadence_prefrozen.rule: control event at optimizer step t happens BEFORE step t (state = end of step t-1); event modifies only step t's gradient; steps 121-128 identical across arms

seeds_prefrozen.rule: never choose seeds by results; expansion only per budget priority

total_steps_prefrozen.reason: = planned_total_optimizer_steps of the frozen v0.7 config; the entire FR A0-line science lives on this planned trajectory (bank states 46-82); going beyond would leave the frozen LR schedule

budget_priority_prefrozen: 1. complete K=20 protocol (A,B,C equal-step + equal-wall-clock, 3 seeds)
4. only if budget remains: 6-seed expansion for K=20

equal_wall_clock_protocol.definition: per (seed,K): T_C = measured wall of arm C full 128-step run (rollout+response+snapshot+restore+candidate+execution+eval all included); then arms A and B each run a wall-clock variant (A_wc, B_wc) consuming the SAME budget T_C (finish current optimizer step after budget exhaust, then final eval)
equal_wall_clock_protocol.primary_metric: Gain_time = L_eval(A_wc @ T_C) - L_eval(C @ 128 steps) per (seed,K); positive = controller better
equal_wall_clock_protocol.pairing: T_C measured and A_wc/B_wc run in the same session immediately after C to share the contention envelope; GPU occupancy logged at each phase

metrics.M2_Gain_time: equal-wall-clock per protocol above (PRIMARY for Q3)
metrics.M3_ROI: Gain_time / T_extra, T_extra = T_C - T_A128 (measured pure-128-step wall of arm A same session); per second
metrics.M4_action_success: per control event from offline counterfactual replay: chosen action short-horizon dual-label gains vs no-op branch; positive rate, harmful rate, no-op rate (j*=0 fraction); replay branches: no-op, fixed j=1, chosen j*, H=4 rollout on the event stream with injection at horizon 1, dual V_score/V_eval labels, frozen A0H20 replay semantics
metrics.M5_adaptive_advantage: equal-step C vs B at 128 (primary) + equal-wall-clock C vs B at T_C

per_event_log_fields.offline_reconstruct_note: chosen_id must be recomputable as argmin_j(lambda*hhat_j) with tie->smallest id from logged hhat alone; hhat_0=0.0 logged explicitly
forbidden_this_round: use V_eval feedback to adjust the controller
choose seeds or K from results
stale or cached gradients/p/w in the live loop
new data action definition (candidates = frozen 4 data groups; lookahead = E2 recipe stream)

interpretation_cases.Case_A: equal-step gain > 0 AND Gain_time > 0 -> net training benefit; next: block planning/efficiency (NOT auto-started)
interpretation_cases.Case_B: equal-step gain > 0 BUT Gain_time <= 0 -> signal works, single-step economics insufficient; next: widen decision coverage
interpretation_cases.Case_C: equal-step gain <= 0 -> problem is not compute; revisit action space / score-eval transfer / intervention magnitude

retry_rule: infra/serialization-class retries only under same frozen contract/manifest; no env upgrades; no killing external tasks; no commit/push/reset; module hash changes logged in live_manifest BEFORE any results viewed
deliverables: runs/ per-run logs + eval trajectories + per-event logs
stop_condition: after A0K reporting: do NOT auto-start A0L / lambda tuning / block planning / optimizer changes; wait for analysis
